label: Squaring the Circle
summary: A geometric treatise on the quadrature of the circle, a problem Leonardo pursued for years.

value.text: no. 92, Science, Mathematics, Engineering and Military

claims.statement: Entered as no. 92 in the reconstructed catalogue of Leonardo's books, under Science, Mathematics, Engineering and Military. Leonardo's wording as rendered there: "the quadrature of the circle".
check_in: Leonardo's autograph book lists: Codex Trivulzianus f. 2r; Codex Atlanticus f. 559r; Madrid Codex II ff. 2v to 3r (which list names this title to be established)

claims.statement: Identified in the reconstruction as Tetragonismus. The identification of a title in Leonardo's lists with a specific work and edition is an interpretation.

sources.cite: Museo Galileo, La Biblioteca di Leonardo, record for this title.
